record.question: Which of the following is correct about Common Proceedings
options: If the authorities competent to impose the penalty of dismissal the Government servants are different, the highest of such authorities may issue an order for taking disciplinary action
A Common Proceeding can also be held against Government servants working in the same office who have made complaint against each other
Common Proceedings can only be conducted when the Government servants belong to the same office
